owner: RoyRiya

title: "[Process Doc Update]: Create README for OctoAcme Project Management Docs with links to all process docs and project management processes summary"
labels: ["documentation", "process improvement"]
body: |
  ## Which process document do you want to update?
  <new document>

  ## Summary of New Content
  Create a comprehensive README for the `docs/` folder that serves as the central entry point for OctoAcme's project management documentation. The README includes:
  
  - **Project Overview**: Brief summary of OctoAcme's project management approach and core principles
  - **Lifecycle Overview**: High-level description of the five project phases (Initiation, Planning, Execution, Release, Retrospective)
  - **Complete Documentation Index**: Organized links to all seven process documentation files
  - **Usage Guide**: Quick reference for which docs to consult at different project stages
  - **Contributing Guidelines**: Instructions for suggesting improvements to the documentation

  This README will democratize access to project management knowledge by providing a single, discoverable entry point for all team members.

  ## Why is this update needed?
  Currently, the process documentation is scattered across individual files with no central index or introduction. New team members and existing team members alike lack a clear entry point to understand OctoAcme's project management approach. A comprehensive README will:
  
  - **Accelerate onboarding**: New team members can quickly understand the overall approach before diving into specific processes
  - **Improve discoverability**: All documentation becomes more findable with clear indexing and navigation
  - **Reduce single-person dependency**: Centralizing knowledge reduces reliance on informal tribal knowledge
  - **Support consistency**: A shared reference point helps ensure all projects follow standardized processes
  - **Enable governance**: Makes it easier to maintain, version, and evolve our processes collaboratively

  ## Suggested Content
  See the README.md file created at `docs/README.md` which includes:
  
  ### Quick Overview Section
  - Core principles of OctoAcme project management
  - Project lifecycle phases with brief descriptions
  
  ### Documentation Index
  Organized into three sections:
  - **Getting Started**: Overview document
  - **Process Guides**: All five main process documents (Initiation, Planning, Execution, Risk/Communication, Release, Retrospective)
  - **Reference**: Roles and personas document
  
  ### How to Use These Docs
  Context-specific guidance for different user scenarios and project stages
  
  ### Contributing Section
  Instructions for suggesting updates using the existing issue template

  ## Acceptance Criteria
  - [x] Content aligns with existing process docs
  - [x] Update improves clarity or closes a documented gap
  - [x] Proposed content has been reviewed with stakeholders (if needed)
